name: Ask 90N
welcome: Hey! I’m Noyon’s portfolio assistant. I can help you explore his work, skills, and broadcast experience. What would you like to know?
disclosure: Quick answers use saved Q&A. Enable on-device AI for natural, context-aware replies.
fallback: I don’t have a verified answer to that in Noyon’s portfolio yet. You can ask about his projects, skills, experience, or get in touch with him directly.

questions.question: What does Noyon do?
questions.answer: Md Nazim Uddin Noyon, also known as 90N Bhai, is a Broadcast Engineer specializing in esports backend production. His work covers live stream operations, overlays, observer integration, scene control, and automation, with a strong focus on Free Fire tournaments.

questions.question: Show me his projects
questions.answer: Explore five featured productions: MR TRIPLE R — 6 Million Special Tournament, RTB Fest 2025, Offline Clash — LQD, T4B × LQD Campus Battle, and MIST Campus Edition. The Projects folder includes 71 production images, plus broadcast links where available.

questions.question: What tools does he use?
questions.answer: Noyon works with vMix and OBS Studio for broadcast production. His software skills include C++, C#, Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. He also uses Excel, Google Sheets, and API workflows for production data and automation.

questions.question: Where has he worked?
questions.answer: His portfolio lists Broadcast Engineer Head at Mangrove Esports (2025–Present), Broadcast Engineer at T4B Officials (2024–2025), and Production Support at Liquid Production (2023–2024).

questions.question: How can I contact him?
questions.answer: For production work or collaboration, email nahid222003@gmail.com. Share the event dates, broadcast requirements, and scope so Noyon can discuss availability and pricing with you. Rates aren’t listed in this portfolio.

questions.question: Can he automate production workflows?
questions.answer: Yes. His portfolio includes Excel and Google Sheets automation, API workflows, and custom programming for backend production utilities. These support repeatable production tasks and live-event data handling.

questions.question: Does he work on Free Fire broadcasts?
questions.answer: Yes. Free Fire esports is a core focus of Noyon’s broadcast work. His portfolio lists 2,500+ live productions and 150+ Free Fire events, with responsibilities across stream setup, switching, graphics, backend coordination, and observer integration.

questions.question: Where can I find his GitHub and social profiles?
questions.answer: His GitHub is github.com/90xExe and his YouTube channel is @90n_bhai. You’ll also find LinkedIn, Facebook, and Discord in the Contact window.

questions.question: Hello
questions.answer: Hey! Great to have you here. Ask me about Noyon’s esports productions, his experience, the tools he uses, or how to get in touch.

questions.question: Thank you
questions.answer: You’re welcome! Feel free to explore the desktop or ask me another question about Noyon’s work.
